operational_decision_point.target_forecast_day: Day D (08:30 IST accumulation ending Day D, corresponding to 03:00 UTC D-1 to 03:00 UTC D)
operational_decision_point.strict_rule: Verifying observation on Day D does NOT exist at 05:30 IST. Any pipeline using Day D observation as a predictor is classified as an oracle retrospective diagnostic and cannot be claimed as an operational forecast.

predictors.name: raw_fcst_mm
predictors.source: Open-Meteo ECMWF IFS 0.25° Previous Runs archive
predictors.valid_time: Day D (24h ending 03:00 UTC Day D)
predictors.availability_at_issue: Available from D-1 12Z operational run distribution (4-6h latency)

predictors.name: rqdm_fcst_mm
predictors.availability_at_issue: Derived strictly from causal Z_effective and training-fold quantile lookup table

predictors.name: elevation_m
predictors.source: Station altitude above mean sea level (meters)

predictors.name: dist_coast_km
predictors.source: Shortest distance to Arabian Sea coastline (km)

predictors.name: wind_u_850
predictors.source: ECMWF IFS 850 hPa zonal wind forecast

predictors.name: wind_v_850
predictors.source: ECMWF IFS 850 hPa meridional wind forecast

predictors.name: orographic_flux
predictors.source: Ridge-normal orographic proxy w_oro = E * (-cos(160)*u + sin(160)*v)
predictors.availability_at_issue: Computed from NWP wind vector and static elevation

predictors.name: regime_code
predictors.availability_at_issue: Computed at 05:30 IST using finalized D-2 and D-1 observations plus Day D NWP forecast
predictors.oracle_exclusion_notice: Verifying observation on Day D is strictly excluded. Any experiment conditioning on actual Day D IMD rain is classified as 'retrospective observation-conditioned / oracle regime'.

predictors.name: mcz_z_score
predictors.source: Core Monsoon Zone standardized effective anomaly Z_effective
predictors.availability_at_issue: Causal composite anomaly available at 05:30 IST

validation_protocol.deployment_validation_caveat: CV trains on both earlier and later seasonal blocks relative to the test fold. It is accurately designated 'retrospective blocked CV' and must NOT be described as rolling-origin deployment validation.
validation_protocol.spatial_grouping: Date-grouped (all 324 stations for a given date are assigned to the same fold)
validation_protocol.purge_rationale: Prevents synoptic multi-day autocorrelation leakage across fold boundaries

stage_2_training_lineage.stage_1_inputs_in_stage_2_train: In-sample Stage 1 predictions on training fold (standard stacking design)
stage_2_training_lineage.outer_test_evaluation: Strictly out-of-fold (Stage 1 and Stage 2 both evaluate on unseen test blocks)
stage_2_training_lineage.contamination_status: No outer-test outcome leakage; documented training-distribution property of stacked regressors
